This passenger privacy policy is a structured draft for TRYP. The legal entity, dates, registered address, Information Officer details, retention periods, processors and launch jurisdiction must be confirmed by the responsible legal owner. This page is not legal advice.

Applies toTRYP passenger services

TRYP ("TRYP", "we", "us", "our") respects the privacy of passengers and is committed to protecting personal information entrusted to us.

This Privacy Policy explains how TRYP collects, uses, stores, protects, shares and otherwise processes personal information when you use the TRYP passenger application, website, services, communications channels and related products and services (collectively, the “Services”).

TRYP operates in accordance with applicable privacy and data-protection laws, including the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA), where applicable. POPIA seeks to protect individuals and organisations from harm arising from improper processing of personal information and establishes conditions for lawful processing.

1. Important information

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully before using TRYP.

By registering for, accessing or using TRYP, you acknowledge that you have been given an opportunity to understand how your personal information is processed.

Where applicable law requires your consent, we will request it separately. You are not required to consent to processing that is not necessary for the provision of the Services merely because you wish to use TRYP. Some processing is necessary to provide the Services and may therefore be based on another lawful basis permitted by applicable law rather than consent.

2. Who is responsible for your information?

The responsible party for personal information processed through TRYP is:

For purposes of applicable data-protection legislation, TRYP may act as the responsible party for personal information processed in connection with the Services. Certain third-party service providers may process information on our behalf as operators or service providers. Where a third party independently determines how and why it processes your information, that third party may have its own privacy policy and legal responsibilities.

3. What personal information do we collect?

We collect only information reasonably required for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. The information we collect may include:

3.1 Account information

  • Full name
  • Mobile phone number
  • Email address
  • Profile photograph, if provided
  • Password or authentication credentials, where applicable
  • Account identifier and status
  • Preferred language and account preferences
  • Date of birth or age information where required
  • Country or region

We may require certain information to create and maintain your account.

4. Phone number verification

TRYP may verify your mobile telephone number through SMS, WhatsApp, voice verification, authentication services or another verification method.

We may process your telephone number, verification codes, verification attempts and timestamps, device information associated with verification, and authentication status.

Verification information is used primarily to confirm account ownership, prevent fake accounts, protect accounts against unauthorised access, reduce fraud, prevent abuse of promotional offers, and protect passengers and drivers.

TRYP will not treat your one-time password as a permanent password and will not intentionally display your verification code publicly.

5. Location information

Location information is one of the most important categories of information processed by an e-hailing platform. When you use TRYP, we may collect location information from your device, including:

  • Current and approximate location
  • Pickup location and destination
  • GPS coordinates
  • Location history associated with trips
  • Route information
  • Driver location in relation to your requested trip
  • Time and date associated with location information

Location information may be collected while you are actively requesting a ride, while a ride is being arranged, during a trip, when required for safety or fraud prevention, and in accordance with the permissions you grant through your device.

Our location promise

TRYP will not use continuous background location tracking merely because the application is installed. Where continuous or background location access is technically necessary for a particular feature, TRYP will explain the reason and request the relevant permission where required.

6. How location information is used

We may use location information to:

  • Identify your pickup location and help drivers locate passengers
  • Calculate routes, estimated journey times and fares
  • Dispatch drivers and monitor trip progress
  • Provide navigation-related functionality
  • Detect suspicious or fraudulent activity
  • Investigate safety incidents and complaints
  • Resolve disputes and improve service availability
  • Comply with legal obligations and respond to emergencies where appropriate

Location data is therefore an essential part of the TRYP service.

7. Location information shared between passengers and drivers

TRYP is designed to allow a passenger and driver to locate and identify one another for the purpose of completing a requested trip.

When you request a ride, a matched driver may receive information necessary to locate your pickup point, identify the passenger associated with the trip, complete the requested journey, contact you through TRYP and navigate to the pickup location.

You may receive information about the matched driver and vehicle necessary to identify the correct vehicle and complete the trip, including:

  • Driver first name or display name and profile photograph
  • Driver rating
  • Vehicle make, model, colour and registration/licence plate
  • Driver or vehicle identification information required for safety
  • Approximate or real-time location during the trip
  • Trip status

TRYP does not intend to provide either party with unrestricted access to the other's personal information.

8. Phone number privacy

Where technically available, TRYP may provide communication functionality that prevents passengers and drivers from unnecessarily exposing their personal telephone numbers to one another. This may include in-app calling, masked telephone numbers, in-app messaging or temporary communication channels.

Where a passenger or driver chooses to communicate outside TRYP, that communication may expose personal information to the other party. TRYP is not responsible for information voluntarily disclosed by a user outside the TRYP platform.

Users should avoid voluntarily sharing identity numbers, banking information, passwords, OTPs, unrelated home addresses, financial credentials or other sensitive personal information.

9. Trip information

For every trip, we may create and retain a trip record. This may include:

  • Request time, pickup location, destination and route
  • Trip start and completion times
  • Driver and vehicle assigned
  • Ride category, fare and payment method
  • Trip status, cancellation information, distance and duration
  • Ratings, complaints, support interactions and safety incidents
  • Relevant communications

Trip records are necessary for operating the platform and protecting both passengers and drivers.

10. Payment information

Where you pay for a TRYP ride electronically, payment information may be processed through third-party payment providers. Depending on the payment method, TRYP may process payment status, transaction amount and reference, payment method, partial payment-card information, provider identifiers, refund information and chargeback information.

Where possible, TRYP will not store complete payment-card numbers or security codes on its own systems. Payment information may be processed directly by authorised payment service providers according to their own privacy policies and applicable laws.

TRYP may retain transaction records necessary for accounting, refunds, disputes, fraud prevention, chargebacks, tax obligations and legal compliance.

11. Cash payments

If TRYP offers cash payments, we may record the fare amount, payment status, outstanding amount, driver/passenger payment disputes, and cancellation or non-payment information. TRYP may use this information to investigate disputes and prevent repeated abuse.

12. Device information

When you use the TRYP application, we may automatically collect technical information, including device model, operating system and version, application version, device identifiers, IP address, network information, mobile carrier, language, time zone, crash and diagnostic information, security information and app performance information.

This information may be used to keep the application functioning, detect technical problems, protect accounts, prevent fraud, diagnose crashes, improve performance and maintain security.

13. Camera and photos

TRYP may request access to your camera or photo library where a feature requires it, such as profile photographs, account verification, uploading supporting documentation, submitting evidence to customer support or reporting an incident.

TRYP will not access your entire photo library simply because the application has the technical capability to request such access. Where supported by your device, TRYP will request the minimum permission necessary.

14. Contacts

TRYP does not require access to your contacts merely to provide ordinary ride-hailing functionality. If a future feature requires contact access, TRYP will explain the purpose before requesting permission. You may refuse permission unless access is necessary for a feature you specifically choose to use.

15. Emergency and safety information

TRYP may process information relating to safety incidents and emergencies, including emergency and accident reports, complaints, trip location, driver/passenger identification, relevant communications, incident timestamps, information supplied by emergency contacts or responders, and evidence supplied by users.

Where reasonably necessary to protect life, physical safety or prevent serious harm, TRYP may process or disclose relevant information to appropriate persons or authorities as permitted or required by law. Emergency processing may occur without ordinary user consent where applicable law permits or requires it.

16. Emergency contacts

If TRYP provides an emergency-contact feature, you may choose to provide another person's details. Before providing another person's information, you should have the authority or permission required by applicable law and provide only information necessary for the feature.

TRYP may use an emergency contact solely for safety notifications, emergency assistance, trip-sharing, incident communication or other functionality clearly explained when the contact is added. TRYP does not sell emergency-contact information.

17. Ratings and reviews

After a trip, passengers and drivers may be allowed to rate one another. Ratings may be used to maintain service quality, protect users, detect problematic behaviour, investigate complaints and improve the platform.

A user's rating may be associated with their TRYP account and may influence platform functionality. TRYP may restrict, suspend or terminate accounts where repeated ratings, complaints or other evidence indicate serious or repeated violations of platform rules. TRYP may also investigate whether ratings are fraudulent, retaliatory, discriminatory or abusive.

18. Communications

TRYP may communicate with you through SMS, WhatsApp where applicable, email, push notifications, in-app messages, telephone calls or other electronic methods.

Communications may concern verification, ride requests, driver arrival, trip status, payments, receipts, safety, security, account activity, customer support, important changes to the Services and legal notices.

Some service communications are essential and cannot be disabled while you maintain an active account.

19. Marketing communications

Where required by law, TRYP will obtain appropriate consent before sending direct marketing communications. Marketing may include promotions, discounts, new services, partnerships, special offers and referral programmes.

You may unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time using the available unsubscribe mechanism or by contacting us. Unsubscribing from marketing does not necessarily stop operational communications.

20. How we use personal information

Providing the TRYP service

Creating accounts, matching passengers and drivers, processing ride requests, providing navigation-related functionality, processing payments, providing receipts and customer support.

Safety and security

Protecting passengers and drivers, detecting suspicious behaviour, investigating incidents, preventing account takeover, preventing fraud and investigating threats.

Platform integrity

Detecting fake accounts, GPS manipulation, fraudulent trips, payment and promotional abuse, and multiple accounts used for improper purposes.

Legal compliance

Responding to lawful requests, complying with court orders and regulatory requirements, maintaining records, and exercising or defending legal rights.

Service improvement

Understanding service usage, improving application performance, improving matching and safety, and analysing aggregated trends.

21. Lawful processing

TRYP will process personal information only where there is an appropriate lawful basis under applicable law. Depending on the circumstances, processing may be based on consent, performance of a contract, steps necessary before entering into a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, legitimate interests where permitted, protection of life or safety where permitted, or another lawful ground recognised by applicable law.

POPIA establishes conditions for lawful processing and requires responsible parties to process personal information in accordance with those conditions.

22. We do not sell personal information

TRYP does not sell your personal information as a product. We may, however, disclose or provide access to personal information to service providers where necessary to operate the platform. This is fundamentally different from selling personal information.

Examples may include cloud hosting, payment processing, SMS, authentication, mapping, customer-support, fraud-prevention, analytics and security providers. Where appropriate, these parties will be contractually required to protect information and process it only for authorised purposes.

23. Information shared with drivers

When you request a ride, TRYP may provide a matched driver with your name or display name, pickup location, destination where necessary, relevant trip details, profile photograph where applicable, and information necessary for communication and safety.

The driver does not receive unrestricted access to your TRYP account. Drivers may not use passenger information for unrelated purposes.

24. Information shared with passengers

Passengers may receive information necessary to identify and interact with their matched driver, including driver name and profile photograph, rating, vehicle details, registration/licence plate, vehicle colour, relevant identification information, and approximate or live vehicle location during an active trip.

This information is provided primarily for identification, safety and trip completion. Passengers must not misuse driver information.

25. Prohibited use of user information

Passengers and drivers may not use information obtained through TRYP to:

  • Harass, stalk, threaten or extort another person
  • Contact another person for unrelated commercial purposes
  • Sell, publish or misuse another person's information
  • Create fake accounts or identify another person outside legitimate TRYP purposes
  • Monitor another person after a trip
  • Circumvent TRYP safety measures

Violation may result in suspension or termination of an account and may be reported to appropriate authorities where appropriate.

26. Third-party service providers

TRYP relies on selected third parties to operate components of the Services, including cloud infrastructure, maps and geolocation, payment processing, SMS/WhatsApp, email, authentication, analytics, crash reporting, customer support, fraud prevention and security services.

We seek to ensure that third-party service providers receive only information reasonably required for the service they provide.

27. International data transfers

Some TRYP service providers may operate outside South Africa. Consequently, personal information may be processed or stored outside South Africa.

Where personal information is transferred across borders, TRYP will take reasonable steps to ensure that the transfer is conducted in accordance with applicable law. Where required, TRYP may use contractual protections, data-processing agreements, adequacy mechanisms, user consent where legally appropriate, or other lawful mechanisms.

28. Data security

TRYP takes reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against loss, theft, unauthorised access or disclosure, unauthorised modification, accidental destruction and unlawful processing.

Security measures may include encryption in transit, encryption where appropriate at rest, access and authentication controls, role-based access, logging, monitoring, security testing, infrastructure security, backups and employee confidentiality obligations.

However, no internet-connected system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. You should protect your account credentials and never disclose your OTP, password or authentication credentials to another person.

29. Account security

You are responsible for maintaining reasonable security over your account. You must keep authentication credentials confidential, not share OTPs, not allow another person to use your account, notify TRYP if you suspect unauthorised access, and keep your device reasonably secure.

TRYP will never intentionally ask you to disclose a one-time authentication code for purposes unrelated to authentication. If you believe your account has been compromised, contact TRYP immediately.

30. Fraud prevention

TRYP may analyse account, device, payment, location, trip and behavioural information to identify suspected fraud or abuse, including fake or stolen accounts, account sharing, payment fraud, GPS spoofing, promotional abuse, repeated cancellations, fake trips, collusion, chargeback abuse and unusual account behaviour.

Where appropriate, TRYP may automatically flag activity for further investigation.

31. Automated decision-making

TRYP may use automated systems to assist with fraud detection, account security, driver/passenger matching, pricing calculations, service availability, risk assessment and detection of suspicious activity.

Automated systems may produce recommendations, warnings or restrictions. Where applicable law gives you rights concerning automated decision-making, TRYP will provide appropriate mechanisms for review or challenge. TRYP does not intend for automated systems to replace human review where applicable law requires meaningful human intervention.

32. Account suspension and safety decisions

TRYP may temporarily restrict an account where reasonably necessary to protect another person, investigate suspected fraud or serious safety incidents, prevent unlawful activity, protect the platform or comply with law.

Where appropriate and legally permissible, TRYP may provide information about the reason for the restriction and an opportunity to contact support. TRYP may temporarily withhold certain information where disclosure would compromise an investigation, create a safety risk, enable fraud, violate another person's privacy or breach a legal obligation.

33. Safety investigations

When a passenger or driver reports a serious incident, TRYP may investigate. Information considered may include trip, location, account, rating, complaint, communication, payment, device and submitted evidence information, along with other relevant information lawfully available to TRYP.

The purpose is to establish relevant facts, protect users and determine appropriate action.

34. Audio, video and recordings

If TRYP introduces an audio-recording, video-recording or safety-recording feature, the applicable functionality will provide appropriate notices and permissions where required.

Where recordings are collected, they may be used for safety, incident investigation, dispute resolution, fraud prevention and legal compliance. Recordings will not be used for unrelated purposes except where permitted by law. The specific retention period for recordings may differ from ordinary trip information.

35. Cookies and analytics

The TRYP website may use cookies and similar technologies for website functionality, security, performance, analytics, preferences and marketing where legally permitted.

The mobile application may use equivalent technologies such as SDKs, local storage and device identifiers.

36. Aggregated and de-identified information

TRYP may create aggregated or de-identified information from personal information, such as number of trips, average trip duration, general service demand, popular service areas and application performance.

Where information has been properly de-identified so individuals cannot reasonably be identified, it may be used for analytics, research, service improvement or business purposes.

37. Children

TRYP is not intended to be used by children who are not legally permitted to independently use the Services. TRYP may require age information or other verification where necessary.

Where we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child in circumstances where processing is not permitted by applicable law, we may take reasonable steps to delete or restrict that information. Where applicable law requires parental or guardian consent, TRYP will follow the applicable requirements.

38. Your privacy rights

Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:

  • Know what personal information we hold about you
  • Request access to personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion where legally applicable
  • Object to certain processing
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
  • Request information about how your personal information is used
  • Lodge a complaint concerning our processing
  • Exercise other rights provided by applicable law

39. Withdrawing consent

Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent. Withdrawal does not necessarily invalidate processing that occurred before withdrawal and may not be possible where TRYP has another lawful basis for processing the information.

You generally cannot require TRYP to stop processing information necessary to complete a ride, process a payment, maintain legally required records, investigate fraud, protect users or comply with law.

40. Requesting access to your information

You may contact TRYP to request access to personal information held about you. To protect users against unauthorised disclosure, TRYP may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request. We may decline or limit a request where permitted by law.

41. Correcting your information

You should ensure that your personal information is accurate and current. You may update information through the application where the relevant functionality is available or contact TRYP support. We may require verification before making certain changes.

42. Deleting your account

You may request deletion of your TRYP account, subject to applicable law. Account deletion does not necessarily mean that every record is immediately destroyed.

TRYP may retain certain information where necessary for legal compliance, tax and accounting, fraud prevention, security, dispute resolution, legal claims, regulatory obligations or enforcement of agreements. Where retention is no longer necessary, information will be deleted, anonymised or securely disposed of in accordance with our retention practices.

43. Data retention

TRYP does not intend to retain personal information indefinitely without a legitimate reason. Different categories of information may have different retention periods.

Account informationWhile the account remains active and for a reasonable period afterwards where required.
Trip informationFor operational, accounting, safety, dispute and legal purposes.
Payment recordsFor accounting, tax, fraud and financial-record purposes.
Safety and incident recordsAs reasonably necessary to investigate and resolve an incident or meet legal obligations.
Authentication recordsFor security and fraud-prevention purposes.
Support communicationsFor quality, dispute and legal purposes.
Marketing preferencesTo ensure that marketing preferences are respected.

44. Legal requests

TRYP may disclose personal information where reasonably necessary to comply with a valid court order or legislation, respond to lawful government requests, protect life or physical safety, investigate suspected unlawful activity, prevent fraud, protect the rights and property of TRYP, or defend legal claims.

TRYP will not voluntarily disclose personal information simply because another person asks for it.

45. Police and law enforcement

Where law enforcement requests information, TRYP may require appropriate legal authority where required, including court orders, warrants, statutory authority or other lawful requests.

In emergencies involving an imminent threat to life or serious physical harm, TRYP may disclose relevant information where legally permitted. Where legally permitted, TRYP may notify affected users of certain requests, but notification may not be possible where prohibited by law or where it could compromise an investigation or create a safety risk.

46. Disputes between passengers and drivers

TRYP may process information necessary to investigate disputes between passengers and drivers, including trip details, location information, communication records, ratings, payment records, complaint information and evidence submitted by either party.

TRYP will attempt to limit disclosure to information reasonably necessary to resolve the dispute. A passenger does not automatically have the right to receive a driver's private personal information merely because a dispute exists, and a driver does not automatically have that right regarding a passenger.

47. Third-party links

The TRYP application or website may contain links to third-party websites or services. TRYP is not responsible for the privacy practices of third parties that operate independently from TRYP. You should review the relevant third party's privacy policy before providing information to that party.

48. Business transfers

If TRYP is involved in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, sale of assets, investment, corporate reorganisation, insolvency or similar transaction, personal information may be transferred as part of the relevant transaction, subject to applicable law. TRYP will take reasonable steps to protect personal information during such transactions.

49. Employees and contractors

TRYP may allow authorised employees, contractors and service providers to access personal information where necessary for their work. Access should be limited according to role, business necessity, security requirements and confidentiality obligations. Employees and contractors may not use personal information for personal purposes.

50. Confidentiality

TRYP expects employees, contractors, drivers and other authorised persons who have access to personal information to treat that information as confidential.

Unauthorised use or disclosure may result in account restrictions, employment or contractual consequences, suspension, termination, civil proceedings or criminal referral where appropriate.

51. Data breaches

If TRYP experiences a security compromise involving personal information, we will take reasonable steps to:

  1. Identify and contain the incident
  2. Investigate what happened
  3. Assess affected information
  4. Take corrective measures
  5. Strengthen security controls
  6. Notify relevant authorities where required
  7. Notify affected data subjects where required by applicable law

TRYP will comply with applicable legal requirements concerning security compromises and notification obligations.

52. Your responsibility to protect your information

TRYP cannot protect information that you voluntarily publish or disclose outside the Services. You should never share your OTP, password or payment credentials, give another person access to your account, publish trip information publicly, share your private home address unnecessarily, or send identity documents to unofficial TRYP accounts.

TRYP will not be responsible for information you voluntarily disclose to another user outside the intended functionality of the Services, except where applicable law provides otherwise.

53. Privacy of other people

If you provide TRYP with another person's personal information, you must ensure that you are authorised to provide that information where required by law. For example, if you provide an emergency contact's information, you should ensure that the person is aware where appropriate.

You must not use TRYP to collect personal information about another person without a legitimate reason.

54. User-generated content

If TRYP allows users to submit profile photographs, reviews, complaints, photos, videos, documents or messages, TRYP may process that content for the purposes for which it was submitted.

Users must not upload unlawful, threatening, abusive, defamatory, discriminatory or privacy-invasive content.

55. Profile photographs

Where profile photographs are used, they may be visible to the other party during an active trip or when necessary for identification. The purpose is primarily safety, identification, fraud prevention and service operation.

Users should not copy, distribute or misuse another user's profile photograph.

56. Ratings, safety and privacy balance

TRYP recognises that passenger and driver safety sometimes requires information to be shared. At the same time, safety does not give either party unlimited access to the other's private information.

Only when necessary.Only with authorised persons.Only for a legitimate purpose.Only for as long as reasonably necessary.

57. Marketing partners

Where TRYP works with marketing or commercial partners, we may share limited information where legally permitted and necessary for the relevant programme.

TRYP will not provide marketing partners with unrestricted access to your trip history or precise location merely because you use TRYP. Where required, consent will be obtained before direct marketing involving personal information.

58. Service analytics

TRYP may analyse usage information to understand which features are used, where service demand exists, how applications perform, how frequently errors occur and how users interact with the application. Analytics may be aggregated or de-identified where reasonably possible.

59. Privacy by design

TRYP intends to incorporate privacy into the design of its Services. This includes data minimisation, purpose limitation, access controls, security, limited retention, user transparency, privacy-conscious communication and restricted disclosure.

TRYP aims to collect only information necessary for a defined purpose and securely delete information that is no longer needed.

60. Changes to this Privacy Policy

TRYP may update this Privacy Policy from time to time because of new features, technology, changes to the Services, changes in law, regulatory guidance, security improvements or business requirements.

Where changes are material, TRYP may provide additional notice through the application, website, email or another appropriate method. The updated version will display a new “Last Updated” date.

61. Contacting TRYP

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the way TRYP processes your information, contact:

TRYP Privacy Teamprivacy@tryp.co.zaInformation Officer: [INSERT NAME]Company: [INSERT LEGAL ENTITY]Address: [INSERT REGISTERED ADDRESS]

62. Privacy complaints

If you believe that TRYP has processed your personal information unlawfully, you should first contact TRYP so that we can investigate and attempt to resolve the matter.

You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator of South Africa, the independent authority responsible for monitoring and enforcing compliance with POPIA and PAIA.

Information Regulatorinforegulator.org.za ↗enquiries@inforegulator.org.za

63. Governing law

This Privacy Policy shall be interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of South Africa, subject to any mandatory rights or protections that apply to you under applicable law.

64. Severability

If any provision of this Privacy Policy is found to be invalid, unlawful or unenforceable, that provision shall be interpreted or modified to the extent necessary to make it lawful and enforceable, and the remaining provisions shall continue to apply to the extent permitted by law.

65. No waiver of legal rights

Nothing in this Privacy Policy is intended to exclude or unlawfully limit any right or protection that cannot legally be excluded or limited. Where applicable law provides a greater level of protection than this Privacy Policy, the applicable law will prevail.

66. Complete privacy notice

This Privacy Policy describes TRYP's general practices concerning personal information. Additional notices may apply to particular features or services, including driver accounts, driver identity verification, payment processing, safety recording, promotions, business accounts, corporate customers and specific location-based services.

Where a specific notice applies, it should be read together with this Privacy Policy.

67. Final privacy principle

TRYP recognises that an e-hailing platform creates a unique privacy relationship. A passenger needs enough information about a driver to know that they are entering the correct vehicle. A driver needs enough information about a passenger to locate and safely transport that passenger. Neither party, however, should receive unnecessary access to the other's private life.

The information necessary to make the ride safe should be available to the people who need it. The information that is not necessary should remain private.
